item.title: The 3-2-1 Code Challenge
item.description:
Idea

A weekly checklist with the goal of honing my tech skills and finding me a job in the area. The idea came about after I was looking for ways to be more productive (and get a job faster!)

Execution

Simple checklist, cannot get it wrong.

  • ✅ 3 programming exercises from Leetcode
  • ✅ 2 job applications
  • ✅ 1 blog post

Then, I will update this post weekly with the list and some stats. Hope it works!

item.title: The Iberian Peninsula Blackout of 2025
item.description:
• Wikipedia Article

11:30 WEST

I was finishing a few quality checks when the lights went out. It had happened a couple of times that month due to some repairs at the office, so we got back to work with cellphone data for some time. A few minutes later, though, the gossip began.

Porto and Lisbon are without light as well.

Have you heard about it? Airports and hospitals in Porto alre already using emergency power.

item.title: How to Create a Hugo Blog Using GitHub
item.description:
I am a professional developer, but I believe you do not need to be one to build a blog with some code. There are many tools out there that (usually with a fee) allow us to create websites without programming, and it is okay to use them.

However, if you, like me, just want a simple blog that you’d like to have control over, likes to code you can go with this approach.
